scope: whole project (next-learn/dashboard/final-example, App Router, Next latest, React latest, TS strict)

findings.title: page search param is not range-validated; negative values produce a negative SQL OFFSET
findings.explanation: currentPage = Number(searchParams?.page) || 1 only falls back for NaN/0. A URL like ?page=-1 yields -1, and fetchFilteredInvoices (app/lib/data.ts:93) computes offset = (currentPage - 1) * ITEMS_PER_PAGE = -12, passed to "OFFSET ${offset}". PostgreSQL rejects a negative OFFSET (assumption: stock Postgres behavior), so the table throws and the user sees the error boundary. Non-integers like 1.5 are also passed through.
findings.suggested_fix: Clamp and normalize: const currentPage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(Number(searchParams?.page)) || 1); optionally also clamp to totalPages.

findings.title: Icon-only links have no accessible name
findings.explanation: UpdateInvoice renders a Link whose only child is a Heroicon SVG (decorative, aria-hidden by default), so the edit link is announced as an unnamed link. The same pattern exists for the previous/next arrow links in app/ui/invoices/pagination.tsx (PaginationArrow, lines 120-122), whose only content is an arrow icon. DeleteInvoice in the same file correctly uses Delete.
findings.evidence:
<Link
      href={`/dashboard/invoices/${id}/edit`}
      className="rounded-md border p-2 hover:bg-gray-100"
    >
      <PencilIcon className="w-5" />
    </Link>
findings.suggested_fix: Add Edit invoice inside UpdateInvoice, and aria-label="Previous page" / "Next page" on the pagination arrow Links.

findings.title: Search input is not associated with its label
findings.explanation: The <label htmlFor="search"> points to id "search", but the <input> rendered at line 32 has no id attribute (lines 32-39), so the label is not connected to any control. Screen-reader users get at best the placeholder as fallback name, and clicking the label does nothing. The component is used on both /dashboard/invoices and /dashboard/customers.
findings.suggested_fix: Add id="search" to the input (or use aria-label={placeholder}).

findings.title: process.env.POSTGRES_URL! asserted non-null in several modules
findings.explanation: process.env values are string | undefined; the ! hides the missing-variable case, so a misconfigured deployment fails later with a confusing connection error instead of a clear message. Same pattern in auth.ts:9, app/lib/actions.ts:10, app/seed/route.ts:5 and app/query/route.ts:3, each creating its own postgres client.
findings.suggested_fix: Create one shared sql client module that checks the variable and throws an explicit error if it is missing; import it everywhere.

limitations: Reviewed all source files under app/ plus config, auth and proxy files; skipped lockfiles, images and node_modules.
Color contrast, focus appearance and screen-reader output were not verified from source alone.
ESLint config is not present in the project; lint overlap could not be checked, so lint-covered issues were skipped by default.
Security issues (e.g. unauthenticated server actions and seed route) and business logic (e.g. floating-point amount*100) are out of scope for this review.
Negative OFFSET behavior was inferred from PostgreSQL semantics, not run.
